## Modules

- [Membrane.Audiometer.Peakmeter](https://membrane-audiometer-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Audiometer.Peakmeter.md): This element computes peaks in each channel of the given signal at
regular time intervals, regardless if it receives data or not.
